description: An entry that records no `conditions` is read as maximally conditioned — every callable parameter, at whole-value granularity — so forgetting to record them is over-strict rather than a lie.

diagnostics.message: Call to `eachItem` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the carrier that colors it declares it non-throwing given `cb`, and the argument passed for `cb` is throwing — its body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or pass something non-throwing for `cb`.
